pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED READING: EXTENSIVE READING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.5 Guided Reading: Reading Aloud (2 Sessions) • Articulation • Verbal c
Topic 2.7: Guided Reading: Extensive Reading

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Guided Reading: Extensive Reading. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is reading important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read varied appropriate grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
2. create a reading log to monitor reading activities

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read varied appropriate grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
   In simple words: practise until you can read varied appropriate grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. create a reading log to monitor reading activities
   In simple words: practise until you can create a reading log to monitor reading activities. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Guided Reading: Extensive Reading using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Guided Reading: Extensive Reading in the examples.
2. Explain Guided Reading: Extensive Reading to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Guided Reading: Extensive Reading.
4. Show that you can: read varied appropriate grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Reading: Extensive Reading using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Reading: Extensive Reading important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Conduct a silent reading session to read the materials identified,
2. Prepare a reading log on the texts read indicating key details e.g. author, title, characters, events and personal opinion on text,
3. Communication and Collaboration: These are promoted as the learner contributes to group decision making when collaborating with peers to form a reading club for Arabic materials.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read varied appropriate grade appropriate materials for lifelong learning
2. create a reading log to monitor reading activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
